answer: The old fable says a willow bends but never clones its roots; a ballot must prove the same: each carries a TPM 2.0 attestation quote tied to one endorsement key burned in at manufacture. One key, one ballot. Ten thousand ballots off one rack die by the duplicate-key check: a second ballot reusing one key is rejected, its $25 bond burns — 9,999 fakes cost $249,975. Fielding 10,000 real chips takes 10,000 phones at $50, $500,000 of hardware, plus ten minutes setup per phone — 1,667 hours no automation can skip. A willow roots on one mesa of silicon; the clones wither with their bonds.
